source_references.usage: read-only protocol, parsing, authentication and test-semantics reference; no Python/MCP/DPAPI runtime embedded

verification.reference_source_facts: Timetable protocol and CAS service shape reviewed in the pinned UPC-MCP source and synthetic fixtures.
verification.actual_validation: 2026-11-03: Android 36 emulator completed a real self-account CAS login and a single read-only timetable index/week request, then displayed the week grid/today section and reopened from offline cache. Later the same day M4 completed a real self-account libseat CAS login, app-token/seat-token exchange, /rest/v2/user identity check, and read-only filters/current-reservation calls; no seat layout, booking, cancellation or check-in was executed. A post-review correction added controlled manual-WebView identity binding and session-revision cleanup; it was verified with synthetic Android/JVM tests only and the real CAS was not rerun. No course text, account, credentials, tokens or session values are recorded here. Separately, the six-entry library/space study used six user-authorized local HAR captures: libseat read-only APIs; nspace venue/roomType/date/roomList; seat/seatengine entrance config/index/identity and empty current/near reservations; reservepc two tenants with 8 and 23 reserve items respectively and empty user lists. All captures start from already-authorized pages; no CAS/passport login exchange, token acquisition or write request was captured or executed. M5 follow-up: the nspace entry was verified to redirect to CAS and the independent nspace auth/read-only client was implemented with synthetic protocol/account-isolation tests; no real account was available for an end-to-end nspace login/browse. Chaoxing seat/seatengine remain browser fallbacks and reservepc remains blocked by missing stable tenant context. No real booking/cancel/check-in was executed.
verification.formal_authorization: Not an official client and no official authorization is claimed. The user reports contact with the school; only the user's own account was used for read-only validation.

entries.name: 图书馆座位
entries.authentication: UPC CAS normal form then libspace one-time service callback; app token exchanged for libseat token
entries.verification: M4 unified-account authentication implemented with normal CAS, app-token exchange, seat-token exchange and /rest/v2/user identity verification; a 2026-11-03 emulator test passed real read-only filters and current-reservation calls. The user-authorized 26-entry HAR remains read-only protocol evidence (filters/floors/stats2/settings/announce and an empty current reservation); layout/seat times/history/writes were not captured.

entries.name: 图书馆空间预约（研讨间）
entries.authentication: Same UPC CAS service shape as libseat, but a separate nspace app token obtained through /spa/static/public/api/remoteCasLogin
entries.verification: M5 follow-up: independent nspace CAS entry, app-token exchange and room browsing are implemented. The entry 302 to CAS was checked; protocol/account-isolation tests pass. No real account was available for an end-to-end nspace login/browse, and saveReservation/cancel/check-in remain unimplemented. The 25-entry HAR remains read-only browsing evidence (1 venue, 4 room types, 3 dates, 6/11 rooms on page 1); no live personal record or write is claimed. Booking stays on the official school page.

entries.name: 超星座位预约（古镇口东区/求是图书馆入口）
entries.authentication: Unauthenticated entries redirect to passport2.chaoxing.com; the 2026-11-03 captures start from already-authorized pages and contain no passport/CAS login exchange
entries.verification: 97-entry seat and 98-entry seatengine HARs captured entrance config, index, identity/verify and empty current/near reservations only. No room/seat/time list, login acquisition, error state or write was captured; one-time page/context values must not be reused. M5 exposes these two stable entry URLs as browser fallbacks only, not native queries.

entries.name: 超星研讨间预约（古镇口东区/求是图书馆入口）
entries.authentication: Tenant/session-dependent reservepc app; without matching context the entry returns a local 303 error page; the 2026-11-03 captures contain no passport/CAS login exchange and no Cookie/Authorization header
entries.verification: Two 93-entry HARs (one per tenant) captured the same read-only API set: reserve/info, user/view/flag, open/team, item/list/time, seat/person/role and dialog; they returned 8 (tenant A) and 23 (tenant B) reserve items, empty reserveUserList and loginStatus=true. No booking detail, cancel/check-in, error state, login acquisition or write was captured. M5 shows both entries as blocked because no stable parameterless/tenant entry is available; the bare URL 303 does not invalidate the live session.
